mascot_brand_identity.name: Мудрый Фили (Wizard AI Mascot)
mascot_brand_identity.description: Cute wizard owl with a periwinkle magic hat and round spectacles. Central AI Tutor avatar across landing, onboarding, practice engine, diagnostic results, and AI chat.
visual_elements: Custom SVG wizard avatar with magical sparkle aura
Botanical leaf and star constellation line-art accents in card backgrounds
Interactive wizard action prompts: 'Фили объяснит', 'Проверить решение', 'Дать подсказку'

component_guidelines.navigation: Desktop left sidebar (#182238 dark navy) with active pill indicators, user avatar, countdown timer badge; Mobile top navbar with smooth sheet drawer.
component_guidelines.cards: Soft rounded cards (rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl) in crisp white (#FFFFFF) or warm tint (#FAF8F3), 1px subtle border (#E5DEC9), soft diffuse box-shadow (shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(30,42,74,0.05)]).

buttons.primary: bg-[#1E2A4A] text-white hover:bg-[#2B3A60] active:scale-[0.98] rounded-xl px-6 py-3 font-semibold shadow-md transition-all
buttons.accent: bg-[#7C66DC] text-white hover:bg-[#6853C8] active:scale-[0.98] rounded-xl px-6 py-3 font-semibold shadow-md transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-[#F0EBE1] text-[#1E2A4A] hover:bg-[#E2DACB] rounded-xl px-5 py-2.5 font-medium transition-all
buttons.outline: border border-[#1E2A4A]/20 text-[#1E2A4A] hover:bg-[#1E2A4A]/5 rounded-xl px-5 py-2.5 font-medium transition-all

component_guidelines.charts: Circular SVG donut progress rings for subject mastery, Recharts for 14-day study frequency & score progression.

key_features_layout: Landing Hero with Wizard Mascot & quick CTA to Diagnostic Test
Auth Modal / Flow (Login & Register in Russian)
Onboarding 3-step Wizard (Subject selection: Математика профиль, Русский язык, Обществознание, Физика, Информатика, История, Биология; Target score 0-100; Exam date picker)
Diagnostic Test interactive mode with instant AI wizard explanations
Knowledge Mastery Profile with Donut charts per topic
Dashboard with countdown widget ('До ЕГЭ осталось 124 дня'), daily study goals, weak topic alerts
Personalized Study Plan (Daily timeline & Weekly calendar toggle)
Hierarchical Topics & Interactive Lessons with math/formula renderer and practice tasks
Adaptive Practice Engine with instant feedback and difficulty auto-scaling
Mistake Analysis page ('Работа над ошибками') with filterable review cards
Mock Exams ('Пробные ЕГЭ') with timer, strict scoring, and detailed analysis
AI Tutor Chat ('Чат с Фили') with quick prompt buttons, step-by-step solver, hint generator
Textbook Mode ('Мои учебники') with downloadable formula cheatsheets and summaries
Admin Panel for managing topics, practice questions, and student metrics

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements, inputs, buttons, test cards, tabs, and status badges MUST include data-testid (e.g. data-testid='start-diagnostic-btn', data-testid='subject-card-math', data-testid='ai-chat-send-btn').
testing_and_accessibility.russian_locale: All labels, error messages, placeholders, tooltips, and buttons MUST be in Russian.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a production-grade React + Tailwind app using the existing setup.
Ensure all views (Landing, Auth, Onboarding, Dashboard, Diagnostic, Subjects, Lesson, Practice, Mistakes, Stats, Mocks, AI Chat, Textbooks, Admin) are fully accessible and interactive.
Maintain high aesthetic standards: soft warm background (#F8F5EE), dark navy sidebar (#182238), rounded-2xl cards, purple/lavender accent buttons (#7C66DC), wizard character mascot graphics.
Implement real mock data and full local state / backend API integration so the user can test all features seamlessly.
